fields.description: What the customer sees. An app with none of these is an entitlement with no interface, which is a real thing to be — it still grants its roles and doctypes.

fields.description: Everything this app exposes. One list, three jobs: the DocPerms we write for our own roles, what an entitlement grants, and the allowlist a customer's custom role may draw from. A doctype in no manifest is reachable by nobody, without anyone having to remember to exclude it.
